_format.links: Newest first. The Add link action inserts entries. You can also add one by editing this file.
_format.url: Required. An http:// or https:// address.
_format.title: Optional. Shown as the headline. The address is used when this is empty.
_format.topic: Optional. A short label such as News or Technology. Shown as a tag. It does not have to match a heading in feeds.yml.
_format.added: The day it was saved, YYYY-MM-DD. The Add link action sets this.
_format.note: Optional. Shown on the page. Do not put anything private here.
